"""
ListNode class is provided as a utility class (see ListNode.py).
"""

class PalindromeLinkedList:
    def isPalindrome(self, head):
        if head is None or head.next is None:
            return True

        slow = head
        fast = head

        i = 0
        while fast is not None:
            slow = slow.next
            if fast.next is not None:
                fast = fast.next.next
            else:
                break
            i += 1
        
        prev = None
        curr = slow
        while curr != None:
            nxt = curr.next
            curr.next = prev
            prev = curr
            curr = nxt
        
        

        headA = head
        while prev != None:
            if prev.val != headA.val:
                return False
            prev = prev.next
            headA = headA.next
        
        return True
